programme.title: Masti
programme.desc: Three henpecked friends tired of their respective marriage decide to spice up their lives by indulging in an extramarital affair. But things go downhill very quickly when they become the prime suspects in a deadly murder case.

programme.title: Amba
programme.desc: Prabha marries a debauched Rajendra who later molests his servant's daughter. Rajendra's mother Amba testifies against him, getting him sentenced to death. Prabha then decides to avenge her husband's death.

programme.title: Jaali Note
programme.desc: Inspector Dinesh (Dev Anand) is assigned to stop the recent flood of counterfeit currency notes in Mumbai. He goes undercover and assumes the identity of a thief in order to infiltrate a gang. In the course of his investigation, where he is hobnobbing with criminals, he becomes romantically involved with a female reporter and makes a discovery of shocking personal significance.

programme.title: Maachis
programme.desc: A young man is arrested and tortured for a crime he did not commit. His friend angered by the injustice actualy joins and extremist group to take revenge from the system.

programme.title: Phamous
programme.desc: Passionate men in search of love lust and justice get caught in an endless game of revenge and rivalry leading their city of Chambal into a bullet-riddled mayhem.

programme.title: Jab We Met
programme.desc: The life of a suicidal industrialist takes a sharp turn when he meets a spirited chatterbox on a train journey in this breezy Bollywood romantic comedy.

programme.title: Rajnigandha
programme.desc: Deepa (Vidya Sinha), a highly qualified girl with simple dreams, is betrothed to Sanjay (Amol Palekar), a forgetful, tardy but lovable and caring boyfriend. Deepa goes to Mumbai for a job interview and chances upon Navin (Dinesh Thakur), her old boyfriend from college who was a passionate youngster and has now become a responsible and successful man. Through the course of the story, Deepa finds herself caught in a dilemma as she reminisces her past with Navin and her future with Sanjay. Will Navin's sudden appearance in her life change her heart?

programme.title: Raja Hindustani
programme.desc: A young taxi driver and a rich city girl fall head over heels in love with each other. Defying her family, she marries him and relocates to his village. But her family weaves a web of deception to split them apart.
